claims.content: To achieve a Closed state for the reversible-lane entrance by executing a scheduled sequence of device operations.

goal.raw_text: To achieve a Closed state for the reversible-lane entrance by executing a scheduled sequence of device operations.

claims.content: Operator
The system configuration data utilized for safety screening shall be no more than 3 seconds old.

Safety screening shall be applied to all device commands at the originating control unit, and at all subordinate control units to which the device command or any of its subordinate device commands may be forwarded.

Safety screening shall always be applied to any device command, or command step, by any control unit which directly operates the target entrance closure device(s), just prior to actual command execution.
The Operator issues a command via the control unit console to close the reversible-lane entrance.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator issues a command via the control unit console to close the reversible-lane entrance.

claims.content: The system performs safety screening to determine if execution of the proposed close command would produce a valid reversible lanes configuration.

If the screened command, including any subordinate commands, would result in an unacceptable reversible lanes configuration, the screening check is considered to have failed and the sequence is halted.
CMS messages are changed from 'Open' to 'Closed' beginning with the farthest upstream sign (furthest away from the entrance) and proceeding, in order, downstream (towards the entrance).

The system provides for a specific delay between the message change on each sign and the message change on the next downstream sign; the delay for each sign pair shall equal the time to travel between the two signs at a system specified speed.
Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups are closed in the direction of adjacent freeway traffic (beginning at the shoulder edge and proceeding toward the entrance ramp nose).
Entrance Transverse Pop-ups are closed in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups are closed beginning at the shoulder edge, and progressing toward the ramp nose, next to the reversible lanes.
Wrong Way Transverse Pop-ups are closed in the direction from the reversible lanes toward the freeway.
At any point in a closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.
At any point in a closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status for a closure device, which was previously closed at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.
A 'halted' opening or closing sequence shall cause the system to enter a 'hold' state for a system specified time.

If the offending device status can be corrected within the specified time period, the operator shall be able to enter a 'resume' command in order for the system to attempt to complete the original opening/closing sequence.
All entrance closure devices are confirmed closed in specified sequence order.
CMS messages have been changed from 'Open' to 'Closed' for all signs in the entrance sequence.
